Prashant Kishor to contest Bankipore by-election, challenging BJP

Political strategist Prashant Kishor is set to contest the upcoming Bankipore by-election. His decision to run from this seat, previously held by a BJP leader, poses a significant challenge to the party. The move has generated considerable political discussion regarding the implications for the BJP's standing in the region.
